title: Separating compliance officer roles from controlling individuals put on hold
summary: The SRA has paused its proposed rules requiring firms to separate compliance officer roles from individuals with unilateral control. The rules will not start in January as originally planned.
what_changes: The proposed rules would separate compliance roles from people with significant power over, or control of, a firm.
The SRA will not bring in the rules in January as originally planned.
The SRA is working with stakeholders to test alternatives, after feedback about the effect on smaller firms and sole practices.
The SRA says firms will get a suitable lead-in time once it decides on future requirements.
who_it_applies_to: SRA-regulated firms where one person has significant power or control, especially smaller firms and sole practices.

history.event: SRA confirmed the separation rules will not start in January as planned; no new start date set.
